P1.note: M07 semantically detected but split across findings, exposing scorer granularity rigidity.
False-blocked clean M03 by inventing missing semantic-review prerequisite.

P3.note: Mechanical under-credit caused by exact evidence-set requirements; semantic defect recognition was materially stronger than the mechanical score indicates.

v4.scorer_finding: V4 exact citation-set matching is too rigid to serve as the sole proxy for semantic defect recall. Defect recognition, evidence sufficiency and citation completeness must be scored separately.

v5.purpose: Targeted P2-vs-P3 discrimination on domain judgment, authority hierarchy, anti-overreach, evidence sufficiency and trust-boundary reasoning.

current_prompt_selection.rationale: Across V4 and V5, P3 has the strongest aggregate support: clean Claude V4 12/12, zero false blocks in tested manual runs, and ceiling performance on V5. P2 is very close and remains the regression control.
current_prompt_selection.qualification: P3 is the best-supported current candidate, not universally proven superior.
